svg.title: Connected board assembly — Ing. Alex M. Rivera

g.text: Base retained: THT parts and male J1/J4 on B; SMD on F. Existing copper unchanged.
Upper: XIAO + ADS1115 + J5 on B (UP); female SMD sockets and C5 on F (BELOW).
Upper routing: F.Cu only. Base has user routing on F.Cu and B.Cu; no edits made.
14 mm PCB top-to-top spacing; approximately 35.6 mm total including 1 mm below base.
35 mm fit is unverified. Allow 36–38 mm before lid and cable-bend allowances.
Stock THT tails shown untrimmed. Select compatible long pins; support both boards and ADC.
USB: phone → cut cable → base J2 → J4 → upper J5 → USB-C male pigtail → XIAO.
Four wires: VBUS / GND / D− / D+. Phone-side OTG/Rd and micro-side legacy plug required.
USB remains toward the left in shared coordinates; verify compact plug clearance physically.
Supplied ADS model prints A3/A2/A1/A0; verify the real module before manufacture.
Upper rev. 0.10 · 13 October 2026 · base as supplied / provisional fit
